string.text: What exactly do you people do around here?
Oh, we shake down all kinds of suckers. We would've grabbed you too, if you hadn't mentioned the Barkeep in time...
I'm assuming you haven't learned to make a living any other way?
Listen, stalker, does that really concern you?
Don't get worked up, I was just asking a question.
They let him go in peace, and now he's here poking around with questions...
Alright, I'd better get going. I can see I'm not quite as welcome here as I was the first time around.
Your boys are here.

Excellent! Alright, listen - there's a door at the lab entrance, the code is 4578. We're going to have a little fun now... \n \nI checked with the Barkeep and you really do have a job from him. Well then, glad I could help. Just watch yourself in there - that lab is a nasty place...
So long.
Alright, Slug gave the green light. Let's move - we're going to their base.
Let's go. We know the way, but we need an escort to take us there.
Alright.
Of course, this is only the beginning, friend.
Hey, was it you who sent me that message? What's this about?
Hold up, first things first - who the hell are you, sneaking around our territory? Stalkers don't belong here. Period!
Easy there... I'm here on a job for the Barkeep. There's some kind of laboratory I'm on the hunt for. You heard anything about it?
Sent by the Rat himself, huh? Hm... fine, I'll buy that... \n \nBut hold on - a laboratory? What the hell would you want with that, pal?
Like I said, I'm here on a job. So, do you know where the entrance is or not?

Heh, as a matter of fact, I do - and I'll tell you, no problem! It's north of here, by the complex. Only catch is the entrance's sealed up tight, so you're not just walking in... 
 
Though there is a way. If you do some work for us. I'm the only one who knows the access code, so you don't really have a choice. 
 
Here's the deal - some idiots from the Cordon showed up thinking they were hot stuff. Three of them, came to mess with the local wildlife for fun. Now they're stuck on a rock out east, two days running, barely fending things off. We've gotten maybe twenty SOS calls from them by now! 
 
Go drag those idiots back to our camp. The guys will set them straight. They're east of here, up on the rocks.
Alright, that sounds easy enough.
Good! Go on then, get moving - we'll figure out what to do with you after.
What do you want with them anyway?

Christ... I told you back at the entrance, this is our turf, stalkers don't get a free pass through here. So yeah, we're gonna teach these "brothers" a lesson... \n \nCrosses already up and waiting for them. We're humane like that, ha!
So you're just going to kill them?
I mean, yeah... What were you hoping for? I'll make it worth your while, I'm feeling generous.
No. I'll bring them to you.
Something to make it worth my while, huh... Alright. \n \nKilling... that I know how to do.

Documents, huh... You'll find death out there alright, that part's guaranteed. Nobody's set foot near here in months, and yet here you are. 
 
The password... sure, let's say I have one. They change it up from time to time, so there's no guarantee it'll even work for you... But - tell you what - bring me a good piece, say an AS Val, plus five bottles of vodka, and we'll talk. 
 
And if you can't find the Val or the vodka, bring five full jars of jelly instead. Full ones, mind you! Anyway... get moving. 
 
Oh, and if you swing by the Bar, tell Snitch that Dead Man says hello.

Oh yeah, that's right. So get this - couple weeks back, some nerd in an orange suit was sniffing around, trying to find a way in. 
 
He stuck around for two days at least, looked like he was hunting for someone to go in with him. The guy was clearly too chicken to go alone. 
 
Anyway, we'd had enough of him... shook him down, took what he had, and booted his ass out of here. We caught the code on his PDA while we were at it - 4230. Write that down before you forget, heh.
